thread:
eva-cs: Heads up — BrightHomes escalated. After last night's model push they see different rerank order for identical requests. They provided request payloads and two different score sets; business logic now picking a different top result.
sam-support: Can you paste the exact payload + the two score arrays (before/after) and X-Request-Id?
eva-cs: Sure, here's one example (redacted customer ids):
```json
{
  "query": "find 2-bedroom condos downtown",
  "candidates": ["A","B","C"],
  "filters": {"price_max": 400000}
}
```
before_scores: [0.812, 0.756, 0.421] (v3.2)
after_scores:  [0.739, 0.763, 0.419] (v3.3-int8)
X-Request-Id: bh-20250610-17a3
Customer timeline: noticed around 2025-06-10T14:50Z.

sam-support: Thanks. Did they use any post-processing thresholding or deterministic tie-breaks?
eva-cs: They say ranking is pure descending score, app-level tie-breaker by candidate id, so score swap changes top-1.

jamie-ml: We rolled v3.3-int8 (quantized) yesterday via canary->prod. No explicit tokenizer version change in model manifest, but int8 conversion pipeline had an updated token merge routine. Deploy logs:
deploy-bot: roll: v3.3-int8 canary start 2025-06-10T14:22Z; promote 100% 2025-06-10T14:40Z.

omar-ops: I checked routing — traffic 100% to v3.3-int8 after 14:40Z; I can pull trace logs if needed.

lina-research: I repro'd locally on dedicated: same payload gives above score inversion. On v3.2 I get [0.812,0.756,0.421], on v3.3-int8 [0.739,0.763,0.419]. Looks like small logit shifts around candidate B vs A.

repro-bot: Ran broad repro across 1k BrightHomes-like queries on staging: 120 (12%) had top-1 flips between v3.2 and v3.3-int8. Flips concentrated on queries with trailing whitespace or HTML-escaped chars.

jamie-ml: We didn't intentionally change tokenizer, but the int8 conversion adjusted the token merging guard that can affect how whitespace is handled at merge boundaries. That could change token sequences slightly which cascades to logits.

omar-ops: Quick experiment: disabled prefix KV cache and reran 100 sample repro on canary (still v3.3-int8) — flips dropped from ~12% -> ~1.2%.

lina-research: Hypothesis: two factors combine: tiny tokenization differences (token sequence checksum changes) + quantization rounding on logits. When softmax differences are small, tokenization shifts flip which candidate gets marginally higher score. Need deterministic tokenization checks.

sam-support: Proposed immediate mitigation: pin BrightHomes traffic to v3.2, open rollback plan if customer impact > threshold, notify customer and offer pinning.

eva-cs: @BrightHomes PM accepted pin to v3.2 for now. I'll open case update and offer temporary workaround.

jamie-ml: I'll open an internal ticket (ML-1152) with a minimal reproducer, token sequence diffs, and model artifacts. Next steps: run full rerank test set across v3.2, v3.3-int8, and v3.3-fp16 and include tokenization checksums for each candidate and the request. Also try quantization with alternative symmetric clamp to see if rounding reduces flips.

lina-research: Add to regression suite: for every model conversion we must run a "same-payload stable-rank" check. If flips > 0.5% on rerank test set, block promotion. Also add a token sequence checksum to the request logs to make post-deploy diffs easier.

deploy-bot: rollback: v3.3-int8 -> v3.2 started 2025-06-10T15:10Z by jamie-ml.
omar-ops: rollback complete 2025-06-10T15:18Z, prod now serving v3.2. Monitoring for follow-ups.

sam-support: I told BrightHomes outcome and rollback. They've asked for a postmortem and ETA for a fix.

eva-cs: Filing postmortem and customer-facing summary. Action items: (1) jamie-ml: reproducer + quantization experiments, (2) lina-research: tokenization checksum instrumentation, (3) ops: add canary cache-off experiment to rollout playbook, (4) support: update BrightHomes status.

jamie-ml: Will have initial reproducer + experiment results in 48h.
lina-research: I'll wire token checksum logging to rerank traces by EOD tomorrow.

sam-support: Thanks all. Marking incident SEV-2 for customer impact and tracking in PMO. :white_check_mark:
